text.description_html:
Acorn AZC-204-3.5, Simplicity Stainless Steel 3.5 Inch Cabinet Pull

This 3.5 Inch Simplicity Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull is a perfect example of how modern design doesn't have to focus on function rather than form. The clean lines of this Acorn cabinet pull look more basic than a traditionally styled cabinet pull yet boring isn't a word that comes to mind while describing it. Sophisticated in design, this cabinet handle is a great way to add a cosmopolitan side to any home without looking as sterile as other contemporary designs can. Available in polished stainless steel or brushed stainless steel finishes.

Also Available: 3 Inch Center to Center Simplicity Cabinet Pull, 4 Inch Center to Center Simplicity Cabinet Pull, and Simplicity Stainless Steel Cabinet Knobs

Specifications for the 3-1/2 Inch Simplicity Cabinet Pull Acorn AZC-204-3.5:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Length (c.c hole spacing): 3.5"
  • Overall Length: 5"
  • Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Available in polished stainless steel or brushed stainless steel.

Sold Individually
